desc: AFTERSHOCK CLP is a high quality one-step cleaner, lubricant, and rust preventative for all aspects of your firearms. It is effective in removing oils, dirt, copper, lead, and other contaminants. It provides a thin, non-greasy coating that prevents rust and lubricates all moving parts of fine firearms and sporting equipment. AFTERSHOCK CLP also nourishes, preserves, and protects wood and leather. It will not harm polymers or other synthetic surfaces. AFTERSHOCK CLP is great for wood stocks and grips, as well as leather holsters, scabbards, and slings. Not recommended for painted surfaces.
